WITH ZZ AS ( SELECT #{writeType} AS WRITE_TYPE , TO_DATE(#{startDate} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS') AS START_DATE , TO_DATE(#{endDate} || '000000', 'YYYYMMDDHH24MISS')+1 AS END_DATE FROM DUAL ) SELECT /*SQL-ID : isry.couns.stats.dscsnstats.mapper.GenderStatsMapper : 성별통계 LIST */ FF.CMMNS_CD_VALUE AS BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD , MAX(FF.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM) AS GUBUN , MAX(FF.SRTNG_SQNCE) AS SRTNG_SQNCE , SUM(DECODE(CC.SXDC_SE_CD, 'M', CC.CCNT, 0) ) AS G1 /* 남 */ , SUM(DECODE(CC.SXDC_SE_CD, 'F', CC.CCNT, 0) ) AS G2 /* 여 */ , SUM(NVL(CC.CCNT, 0)) AS SSUM FROM ( SELECT AA.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD , AA.SXDC_SE_CD , COUNT(*) AS CCNT FROM
AYE100 AA /* 사이버상담게시글 */
AYE120 AA /* 사이버상담답글 */
, ZZ WHERE 1=1
AND AA.FRST_REG_DT >= ZZ.START_DATE AND AA.FRST_REG_DT < ZZ.END_DATE
AND AA.SXDC_SE_CD IN ('M', 'F') GROUP BY AA.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD , AA.SXDC_SE_CD ) CC , ( SELECT AA.* FROM SAC100 AA WHERE 1=1 AND AA.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'MM_DSCSN_STATS_TYPE_SE_CD' /* 월상담통계유형구분코드 */ ) FF WHERE 1=1 AND CC.BBSCTT_TYPE_SE_CD(+) = FF.CMMNS_CD_VALUE GROUP BY FF.CMMNS_CD_VALUE ORDER BY 3
